mission: Unmodified arbitrary public HF dense405B; batch1; total single-GPU VRAM<=8GiB; original output/RNG/successor-state; same-machine4BQ4 p50<=1.2,p95<=1.5; existing TTFT; every cost charged.
scope: Constructive whole-operator algebra and cheapest native/cost gates, not a target executor or broad separator corpus.

hypotheses.principle: Eliminate hidden channels by compiling the quadratic even component of the entire SwiGLU block; derive the remaining odd component explicitly.
hypotheses.tenfold_route: Would require both components to have a complete native executable representation with <=0.1 original dominant traffic/work. A short formula or free odd residual does not qualify.
hypotheses.decisive_tests: Exact quadratic compiler; nonzero odd component when quadratic tensor is zero; full symmetric tensor size; BF16 native rewrite.
hypotheses.novelty: Extends prior consumer symmetry to the actual standard whole block; not asserted a new fundamental principle.

hypotheses.principle: Transport an additive fixed projection into multiplicative monomials before nonlinear activation; compile dyadic weights into exponent programs.
hypotheses.equations: W_ij=2^-q_j A_ij; z_j=exp(2^-q_j x_j); exp((Wx)_i)=product_j z_j^A_ij.
hypotheses.tenfold_route: Requires a short simultaneously evaluable monomial program, bit-exact native lift and charged code traffic. Count an explicit binary-power program before backend work.
hypotheses.decisive_tests: Integer power instruction counts and full-block native gate replacements; retain native up/down cost.
hypotheses.novelty: A concrete alternative representation, not claimed new to mathematics or accepted as a core.

hypotheses.principle: Transport attention queries back through key projection and store latent histories rather than materialized projected keys.
hypotheses.equations: q^T(W_K h)=(W_K^Tq)^T h in real arithmetic.
hypotheses.tenfold_route: Must remove more projection traffic than new transformed-query work/history traffic, preserve rounded key effect and all continuation state.
hypotheses.decisive_tests: Native two-key attention counterexample and latent history width/traffic formulas; no full decoder unless the gate passes.
hypotheses.novelty: Classic duality used as a concrete whole-operation candidate, not counted as an unprecedented principle.

abi: CPU torch BF16 operands, explicit FP32 multiply and balanced add tree, BF16 projection output; SiLU BF16 primitive; BF16 elementwise product; same down reduction. Real identities separate.

scale_example.label: Declared illustrative large-model dimensions, not downloaded checkpoint measurement

reject: Any uncorrected native mismatch rejects that rewrite; >=10x entry gate separate from mission; no zero residual, free primitive, oracle state, or rank/compressibility assumption.
O1_O6: All remain OPEN unless a mission-wide construction independently closes them; scoped algebra cannot close them.
prohibited_extensions: No enlarged complete transition truth tables, no automatic reopening of failed rank/state families, no GPU performance claims, no full backend after rejection.
